summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the new Pillar Series feature. 5/5 backend tests pass and the end-to-end UI flow (logged-out → members flow) works exactly as specified. Pillar 1 is public, Pillar 2 correctly gated with 401 on missing/bogus tokens (no 500s), and members get 200 application/pdf.
